# Mutagen

![Mutagen](../art/cover.jpg)

**The Rulebook.** *A tabletop roleplaying game about freelancers who rebuild their own bodies to survive a city that is rebuilding itself.*

## About This Book

This is the complete game in one document: every rule, the six Augment trees, the threat builder and roster, the starter mission, the Quick Reference, the building guide and a glossary. Chapters keep the numbers used everywhere else (the [Character Builder](https://xenodorian.github.io/BeelzRPG/builder/), the [arcade](https://xenodorian.github.io/BeelzRPG/arcade/), the design notes), and every heading is numbered so you can cite a rule as, say, *§6.4* (positioning) or *§10.5* (building an encounter).

- **New player?** Read chapters 0, 1, 2A and 12, take a pregenerated freelancer from chapter 11, and play.
- **Making a character?** Chapter 2, then chapter 13 walks you through every box, or use the [Character Builder](https://xenodorian.github.io/BeelzRPG/builder/).
- **Running the game?** Part Two. Fights are built from the budget in §10.5; the starter mission is chapter 11.
- **Theatre of the mind or a grid?** Both are full rules ([§6.4](#64-positioning-theatre-of-the-mind-or-grid)). The web arcade plays the grid; [chapter 14](#14-appendix-arcade-vs-tabletop) lists the few places it differs from this book.

*This book is compiled from the chapter files in [the repository](https://github.com/xenodorian/BeelzRPG) by `tools/build_rulebook.py`; the chapters are the source, and a test keeps the two in step. Print edition: [Mutagen_Rulebook.pdf](Mutagen_Rulebook.pdf).*

# Part One: Playing Mutagen

*Everything a player needs: the core roll, building a freelancer, the Augment trees, Surges, Flux, combat, advancement and gear.*

## 0. Introduction — Welcome to Halcyon

![The Spill at Halcyon](../art/setting_halcyon.jpg)

**Mutagen** is a tabletop roleplaying game about freelancers who rebuild their own bodies to survive a city that is rebuilding itself. There are no races and no classes. The Mutagen pulls you toward one of five **Base Forms** (Juggernaut, Skitter, Oracle, Alembic or Siren), and you become whatever you graft on along the way: chitin and venom, chrome and wire, or a twitching mix of both. Twice in your career you **Evolve**, suddenly and violently, into something far bigger. In a fight your body does not always do what you planned; it **Surges**, offering you a random handful of powers from everything you have ever become.

### 0.1 What You Need
- 3–5 players and one Game Master (GM).
- A d20 per player, plus a few d4, d6, d8, d10, and d12.
- A character sheet per player ([sheets/](https://github.com/xenodorian/BeelzRPG/tree/main/sheets)).
- Tokens for **Juice** (coins, beads; 3 per player).

### 0.2 The Setting in One Page
Thirty years ago the **Ostrander Biotech Arcology**, a mile-high lab tower in the coastal megacity of **Halcyon**, cracked open. Millions of litres of **Mutagen**, a programmable living gel, poured into the water table. We call it **the Spill**.

Mutagen does one thing: it makes flesh *accept change*. A dose lets your body grow a new organ, or lets it accept a steel arm without rejection. Untamed, it makes rats fuse into hulks, mould think, and machines grow meat. The national government walled Halcyon off and outsourced the problem.

**G.R.A.F.T.** (Genetic Response And Field Tactics) is the private contractor that won the cleanup bid. GRAFT does not hire soldiers. It licenses **freelancers**: people already saturated with Mutagen who can go where clean humans die. You are one of them. GRAFT pays per mission, sells you upgrades at its clinics, and owns everything you bring back.

**Factions in a sentence each:**
- **GRAFT** — your employer. Polite, underfunded, and lying about what's in the samples.
- **Ostrander Remnant** — the old company, still alive in the upper arcology, sending sterile "Cleaner" squads to erase evidence.
- **The Children of the Bloom** — a faith that believes the Spill is the next step of evolution, and that you are halfway there.
- **The Scrapjacks** — chrome scavengers who strip the dead (and the living) for parts.
- **The Drowned Wards** — ordinary people living in the flooded lower city, trying not to become anything.

### 0.3 Tone
Gritty, weird, and a little funny. Bodies are strange and that is not tragic by default; it can be glorious, gross, or both. Missions are short and dangerous. The city is enormous and mostly unexplored.

### 0.4 The Big Ideas
1. **One roll for everything:** d20 + Stat (+ Rank) against a number. ([Chapter 1](#1-core-rules))
2. **Emotive stats:** Grit, Moxie, Nerve, Gumption, Chutzpah. They describe *how* you do things, not what you are. ([Chapter 2](#2-character-creation))
3. **You are your Form and your Augments:** five Base Forms, each growing along three of six 10-node skill trees (Hide, Limbs, Senses, Glands, Wiring, Mind), each tree grown as **Bio** or installed as **Chrome**. Evolutions at levels 4 and 7 transform your body and your numbers. ([Chapter 2A](#2a-base-forms--evolution), [Chapter 3](#3-augment-trees))
4. **Surges:** you build a personal list of combat powers from mix-and-match parts. Each fight, dice decide which few are ready. Using them is optional; your weapons and Augments always work. ([Chapter 4](#4-surges--the-sequence))
5. **Flux:** every Surge pushes your body closer to **Overload**, where the Mutagen takes the wheel. ([Chapter 5](#5-flux--overload))
6. **Player-facing dice:** the GM rarely rolls. Players roll to hit, and players roll to dodge. ([Chapter 6](#6-combat))
7. **One mission, one level:** a campaign runs 10 missions, levels 1 to 10. ([Chapter 7](#7-advancement))

## 1. Core Rules

Mutagen uses one roll for everything.

### 1.1 The Roll
> **Roll d20 + Stat (+ Rank, if it applies). Meet or beat the target number to succeed.**

- **Stat** is one of your five stats: −1 to +3 at level 1, rising to as high as **+8** as your Base Form Evolves ([Chapter 2A](#2a-base-forms--evolution)), +10 in Final Form.
- **Rank** is your level-based bonus: **Rank = half your level, rounded up** (1 at level 1–2, up to 5 at level 9–10).
- You **always** add Rank to **attack rolls** and **defense rolls**.
- You add Rank to a **check** only if one of your **Knacks** applies.
- Ties go to the player.

There are three kinds of roll:

| Roll | When | Target |
|---|---|---|
| **Check** | You try something risky outside of attacking or defending | A **DC** set by the GM |
| **Attack** | You try to hurt something | The target's **Guard** |
| **Defense** | Something tries to hurt you | The attacker's **Threat Number (TN)** |

The GM almost never rolls. Enemies don't roll to hit you; **you roll to avoid them** (see [Combat](#6-combat)).

### 1.2 Difficulty (DC)

| DC | Difficulty | Example |
|---|---|---|
| — | Trivial | No roll. Just do it. |
| 10 | Easy | Climb a chain-link fence in the rain |
| 13 | Standard | Talk a Ward guard into letting you pass |
| 16 | Hard | Hotwire an Ostrander security door |
| 19 | Extreme | Leap between two moving maglev cars |
| 22 | Mutant | Hold a collapsing ceiling up with your bare (augmented) back |
| 25 | Monstrous | Outrun a maglev; shout down a riot; read a stranger's mind from across a plaza |
| 28 | Mythic | Only an Evolved freelancer's primary stat even has a chance |

Only roll when failure is interesting. On a failure, the GM picks a consequence: you fail, you succeed at a cost, or the situation gets worse.

**DCs don't scale with level.** A locked door is DC 16 whether you're level 1 or 9. Evolved freelancers simply *are* better at things their Form is good at: by level 7, a primary stat of +8 passes a Hard check on an 8+. Raise the stakes instead of the DC: higher-level missions put Extreme and Mutant obstacles in your path, and ask for checks with your weak stats. See [Running the Game](#97-difficulty-across-the-campaign).

### 1.3 Knacks
A **Knack** is a short, specific phrase describing something you're trained in: *Street Medicine*, *Lying to Cops*, *Old Ostrander Tech*, *Parkour*, *Sewer Navigation*. When a Knack fits a check, add your Rank. If it's arguable, the GM decides; lean toward yes for narrow Knacks. You start with 3 Knacks and gain more as you level.

### 1.4 Advantage and Disadvantage
**Advantage:** roll 2d20, keep the higher. **Disadvantage:** roll 2d20, keep the lower. They don't stack; if you have both, roll normally.

**Player-facing rule:** if an *enemy* would have advantage on an attack, the defending player rolls their defense with **disadvantage**, and vice versa.

### 1.5 Natural 20s and 1s
- **Natural 20 on an attack:** a **Crit**. Roll the damage dice twice.
- **Natural 20 on a defense:** you avoid it entirely, and the attacker is **Exposed** (see [Conditions](#68-conditions)).
- **Natural 20 on a check:** success, plus a bonus the GM describes.
- **Natural 1 on anything:** automatic failure.

### 1.6 Group Checks
When the whole party attempts something together (sneaking past, hauling a door), everyone rolls. If at least half succeed, the group succeeds.

### 1.7 Helping
To help someone, describe how and use your Action (in combat) or just do it (outside combat). They roll with advantage.

### 1.8 Juice
**Juice** is a reward token for great play: clever plans, bold roleplay, making the table laugh, or suffering for the story. The GM hands it out.
- You start each session with **1 Juice** and can hold **3**.
- Spend 1 Juice to do **one** of:
  - **Reroll** any d20 you just rolled (use the new result).
  - **Choose a Prime:** set one of your Sequence dice to any result you want (see [Surges](#4-surges--the-sequence)).
  - **Shrug:** end one condition on yourself.

### 1.9 Stats at a Glance

| Stat | It's about | Rolls it covers |
|---|---|---|
| **Grit** | Toughness, force, refusal to fall over | Power melee, lifting, breaking, **Endure** defense, Max HP |
| **Moxie** | Daring, speed, flair under pressure | Finesse melee, sprinting, sneaking, climbing, **Dodge** defense, initiative |
| **Nerve** | Cool head, steady hands, willpower | Ranged attacks, noticing things, **Resist** defense, Flux Limit |
| **Gumption** | Resourcefulness, know-how, figuring it out | Tech, medicine, science, hacking, Analyze, Patch |
| **Chutzpah** | Audacity, charm, nerve-in-your-face | Persuade, lie, intimidate, perform, Taunt, Rally, psionic Surges |

### 1.10 Rest
- **Breather** (about an hour, somewhere quiet): regain **half your Max HP**, Flux drops to **0**. You can take **two** Breathers between Lockdowns.
- **Lockdown** (8 hours in a safe place): regain all HP, Flux to 0, end temporary Overload effects, reset Breathers and "once per Lockdown" abilities.

### 1.11 Time and Distance
Combat runs in **rounds** (about 6 seconds). Distances are in feet. Play them either way ([Positioning](#64-positioning-theatre-of-the-mind-or-grid)): in **theatre of the mind** use **Close** (5 ft, touching), **Near** (up to 30 ft, one move), **Far** (up to 120 ft) and **Distant** (beyond); on a **grid**, 1 square = 5 ft and diagonals count as one square.

### 1.12 Golden Rules
1. **Specific beats general.** An Augment or Surge that says otherwise wins.
2. **Round down** unless told otherwise (minimum 1 for damage).
3. **The GM decides** when the rules are unclear, then writes it down and moves on.

## 2. Character Creation

![A Bio freelancer](../art/char_bio.jpg)

You don't pick a race or a class. You pick **what the Mutagen is turning you into** (your Base Form), **where you came from** (Origin), and **what you've done to your body** (Augments). It takes about 30 minutes; the [web builder](https://xenodorian.github.io/BeelzRPG/builder/) does the maths for you.

### 2.1 Step by Step
1. **Concept.** One sentence. *"Ex-cop with a shotgun arm who can't stop apologising."*
2. **Base Form.** Pick one of the five [Base Forms](#2a-base-forms--evolution): **Juggernaut, Skitter, Oracle, Alembic or Siren**. It sets your best stats, your three trees and how you'll Evolve.
3. **Stats.** Your Form gives **+3** (primary), **+2** (secondary) and **+1** (tertiary). Put **+0** and **−1** in the other two stats, in either order.
4. **Origin.** Pick or roll one (below). Write down its Knack and Perk.
5. **Knacks.** Write **two more** Knacks (3 total). Keep them narrow.
6. **Augments.** Take **6 nodes** from your Form's trees ([chapter 3](#3-augment-trees)): the **Root + 2 Tier I nodes** of your primary tree, the **Root + 1 Tier I node** of your secondary tree, and the **Root** of your tertiary tree. For each tree, choose its **Material: Bio or Chrome**.
7. **Surges.** Build **3 Surges** ([Chapter 4](#4-surges--the-sequence)) and number them 1–3 on your Sequence. Slot 4 is Wild (Lab Escapees build a 4th instead).
8. **Gear.** Take one **Kit** from [Gear](#84-starting-kits) and **50 Scrip**.
9. **Fill in the numbers** (below).
10. **Drive.** Answer three questions: *Why did you take the Mutagen? What do you want before the campaign ends? Who in Halcyon do you owe, or hate?*

### 2.2 Derived Numbers (Level 1)

| Number | Value |
|---|---|
| **Rank** | 1 (half your level, rounded up) |
| **Max HP** | 12 + (2 × Grit) + 5 per level after 1st. Recalculate when Grit changes (it does at each Evolution). |
| **Armor** | From gear and the Hide tree (max 4, unless a node says otherwise) |
| **Speed** | 30 ft (6 squares on a grid) |
| **Flux Limit** | 4 + Rank + Nerve (minimum 4; Splice −1) |
| **Sequence die** | d4 |
| **Prime** | 2 |
| **Signature Surges** | None yet (the first comes at Evolution I, level 4) |
| **Juice** | 1 (max 3) |
| **Defenses** | Dodge = Moxie + Rank, Endure = Grit + Rank, Resist = Nerve + Rank |

### 2.3 The Five Stats
Stats are attitudes, not body parts. A gangly kid can have huge Grit; it means they won't stay down. Your Base Form decides which attitudes the Mutagen feeds, and every Evolution feeds them more (up to **+8**).

- **Grit** — *"I'm still standing."* Raw force and stubborn endurance. Use it to smash, lift, grapple, hit hard in melee, and **Endure** poison, blasts, and crushing blows. It raises your HP.
- **Moxie** — *"Watch this."* Nimble daring. Use it to sprint, climb, sneak, tumble, fight with finesse weapons, and **Dodge** attacks you can see coming. It sets initiative.
- **Nerve** — *"Breathe. Aim."* Composure and willpower. Use it to shoot, notice, track, keep calm, and **Resist** fear, mind control, and psychic attack. It holds your Mutagen together (your **Flux Limit**).
- **Gumption** — *"Hand me that wrench."* Resourceful know-how. Use it to fix, hack, patch wounds, recall lore, read a situation, and **Analyze** enemies.
- **Chutzpah** — *"You and what army?"* Shameless audacity. Use it to persuade, lie, threaten, perform, lead, **Taunt** enemies, **Rally** allies, and power psionic **Dread** Surges.

> **Which defense?** Attacks you can sidestep (claws, bullets, spit) are **Dodge**. Things you must take on the chin (gas, explosions you can't escape, disease, grabs) are **Endure**. Things that attack your mind (fear, hacking your wetware, psychic screams) are **Resist**. Every threat's stat block names the defense.

### 2.4 Origins (roll d6 or choose)

| d6 | Origin | Knack | Perk |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Spill-Born** — raised in the flooded Wards. | *Scavenging* | Advantage on Endure against poison, disease, and anything that adds Flux to you. |
| 2 | **Corporate Washout** — ex-Ostrander staff, fired or fled. | *Corporate Protocol* | Start with +100 Scrip. Once per mission, name an old contact who can open one door. |
| 3 | **Lab Escapee** — you were the experiment. | *Lab Science* | You know **one extra Surge** at every level (it fills a Wild slot; no effect once your Sequence has no Wild slots). It never adds a Signature Surge. |
| 4 | **Clinic Rat** — a street surgeon raised you, or still owns you. | *Street Medicine* | Your Patch action heals +Rank extra HP, and removing Scars or Faults costs you half (the doc wants favours instead). |
| 5 | **Ward Militia** — you held the barricades. | *Squad Tactics* | +2 to your roll in group initiative checks. Once per combat, take Brace as a Quick action. |
| 6 | **Bloom Convert** — the Children took you in. | *Bloom Lore* | Once per Lockdown, reroll an Overload result and choose either result. |

### 2.5 Knack Examples
*Parkour, Knife Fighting, Ostrander Security, Drone Piloting, Sewer Routes, Fast Talk, Interrogation, Chemistry, Mutant Biology, Salvage Appraisal, Street Medicine, Black-Market Contacts, Crowd Work, Lockpicking, Swimming, Gambling, Old Halcyon History, Cooking Anything, Bloom Scripture, Explosives.*

A Knack should be something you could teach in a weekend course or learn on the street in a year. *"Everything Physical"* is not a Knack.

### 2.6 Example: Vex (Level 1)
- **Concept:** Wiry Spill-Born courier with mantis claws who runs messages through gang turf.
- **Form:** **Skitter.** Moxie +3, Gumption +2, Grit +1; she puts **Nerve +0** and **Chutzpah −1**.
- **Origin:** Spill-Born (*Scavenging*). Knacks: *Parkour*, *Gang Turf*.
- **Augments (6):** Wiring (Bio): **Quickened** (Root), **Capacitor**, **Slipstream**. Limbs (Bio): **Natural Weapons** (Root), **Spring Legs**. Senses (Bio): **Keen** (Root). She is all Bio, so Knit heals her 1 × 3 = 3 HP after each fight.
- **Surge parts:** base (Strike, Bolt, Infuse, Kinetic) + Wiring (Shock, Blaze, Haste) + Limbs (Wave, Snare) + Senses (Glare, Veil).
- **Surges:** 1 *Mantis Lunge* (Strike + Kinetic, Moxie), 2 *Live Wire* (Bolt + Shock, Moxie via Wiring), 3 *Slip Veil* (Infuse + Veil). 4 = Wild.
- **Gear:** Sneak kit (two knives, suppressed pistol, Breach kit), Light armor.
- **Numbers:** HP 14, Armor 1, Speed 50 ft (Quickened + Spring Legs), Limit 5 (4 + 1 + 0), Dodge +4, Endure +2, Resist +1. Claws: +4 to hit, 1d8+3, +1d8 Shock once per turn (Capacitor).
- **Her Evolution I** (level 4, Mantis): Moxie +5, Gumption +3, Grit +2, Nerve +1, Chutzpah +0; Prime 3, d8 Sequence, **Mantis Reflex**, and a Signature Surge (she'll pick *Live Wire*).

## 2A. Base Forms & Evolution

The Mutagen doesn't make you *anything*. It makes you into **something**: one of five shapes the city's freelancers keep turning into. That shape is your **Base Form**. It sets your best stats and the three Augment trees you grow along. Twice in your career it **Evolves**, suddenly and violently, into something bigger.

### 2A.1 Choosing a Form

| Form | Primary +3 | Secondary +2 | Tertiary +1 | You place +0 and −1 in | Primary tree | Secondary | Tertiary | In one line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [**Juggernaut**](#2a41-juggernaut) | Grit | Nerve | Chutzpah | Moxie, Gumption | Hide | Limbs | Glands | *"I don't move. You do."* |
| [**Skitter**](#2a42-skitter) | Moxie | Gumption | Grit | Nerve, Chutzpah | Wiring | Limbs | Senses | *"You blinked. I was already there."* |
| [**Oracle**](#2a43-oracle) | Nerve | Chutzpah | Moxie | Grit, Gumption | Senses | Mind | Wiring | *"I saw you coming. Three days ago."* |
| [**Alembic**](#2a44-alembic) | Gumption | Grit | Nerve | Moxie, Chutzpah | Glands | Hide | Mind | *"Hold still. This will either cure you or kill it."* |
| [**Siren**](#2a45-siren) | Chutzpah | Moxie | Gumption | Grit, Nerve | Mind | Wiring | Limbs | *"Everybody look at me."* |

- **Stats:** your Form fixes your +3, +2 and +1. You put **+0** in one of the other two stats and **−1** in the last.
- **Trees:** you take nodes only from your Form's three trees ([chapter 3](#3-augment-trees)): 3 in the primary, 2 in the secondary and 1 in the tertiary at level 1.
- **Material:** for each tree, choose **Bio or Chrome**, as before. A Chrome Oracle and a Bio Oracle both see everything, but one does it with lenses and the other with eyes.
- **Every stat** is primary for one Form, secondary for one and tertiary for one.

### 2A.2 Stages

| Stage | Levels | Primary | Secondary | Tertiary | Dump (+0) | Dump (−1) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Base** | 1–3 | +3 | +2 | +1 | +0 | −1 |
| **Evolution I** | 4–6 | **+5** | +3 | +2 | +1 | +0 |
| **Evolution II** | 7–10 | **+8** | +4 | +3 | +2 | +1 |
| **Final Form** (active) | 10 | **+10** | +4 | +3 | +2 | +1 |

There are no other stat increases. Your stats only change when your body does.

### 2A.3 What an Evolution Gives
**Evolution I** happens at **level 4** and **Evolution II** at **level 7**. Each one gives you all of the following:

| | Evolution I (level 4) | Evolution II (level 7) |
|---|---|---|
| **Stats** | +2 primary, +1 every other stat | +3 primary, +1 every other stat |
| **Prime** | 2 → **3** | 3 → **4** |
| **Sequence die** | d6 → **d8** | d8 → **d12** (skips d10) |
| **Signature Surge** | Your **first** Signature Surge | Your **second** Signature Surge |
| **Evolution node** | Your Form's level 4 node | Your Form's level 7 node |
| **Look** | Your Form's Evolution I look | Your Form's Evolution II look |

Your Max HP, defenses, Flux Limit and attacks all rise with the new stats. **Right after an Evolution, fights get noticeably easier.** The threats of the next few missions catch up with you (see [Threats](#10-threats)).

#### 2A.3.1 Signature Surges
A Signature Surge is the power your new body was built around, and it's always there. You build it from your Surge parts like any Surge, with the Twists your Rank allows, and name it after what your body does now. It sits in its own Signature box (not on your Sequence), it's Primed at the start of every combat and again after each use, so you can Unleash it **once per round**, every round, for its normal Flux. The full rules are in [Signature Surges](#47-signature-surges).
- **Flux is the limit.** You can now Surge every turn, but every Surge pushes you toward Overload. Pace yourself, or plan your Overloads.

#### 2A.3.2 Emergence: the moment it happens
You gain the level, and its numbers, at the debrief like any other level. The **metamorphosis plays out on screen**. At the start of your first turn in the **first combat** of your next mission, you **Emerge**. If you and the GM agree on an earlier moment of terror (a fall, a fire, a friend going Down), it happens then instead.
1. **Describe it.** Use your Form's look below: what splits, what grows, what you hear.
2. **Gain temporary HP equal to 2 × your level.**
3. **Every enemy within 30 ft** that can see you is **Shaken** (Bosses ignore this).
4. The **first time** you Unleash your new Signature Surge this combat, it's **Amped** (0 Flux).

Emerging takes no action. It happens once per Evolution.

> **GM tip.** Before the mission, ask the player: *"What's the first sign it's happening?"* Plant it in the Approach scene: an itch under the plating, a second heartbeat, a voice in the wiring. Optional downtime **Chrysalis** scene: see [Running the Game](#96-evolution-at-the-table).

#### 2A.3.3 Final Form (level 10)
Your third and last stage. At level 10 you take your Form's **Final look** for good. Once per Lockdown, at the start of a combat (after Priming), you may enter **Final Form** until the combat ends:
- **+2 to your primary stat** (to +10).
- **Prime two extra Surges** right away (your Primed maximum rises to match).
- **Every Surge you Unleash is Amped** (0 Flux), Signature Surges included.

---

### 2A.4 The Five Forms

#### 2A.4.1 Juggernaut
**Primary Grit · Secondary Nerve · Tertiary Chutzpah · Dump Moxie and Gumption · Trees: Hide (primary), Limbs (secondary), Glands (tertiary)**

*"I don't move. You do."* The Mutagen decided you should be **unkillable** and started stacking. Juggernauts hold doorways, carry the wounded, and end arguments by standing in them. Grit and Nerve make them hard to hurt and harder to scare, and a little Chutzpah helps them loom. They're slow off the mark and not much for book-learning.

- **Play it if** you want to be the wall: Taunt, intercept, and take the hit meant for your friend.
- **Evolution nodes:** **Siege Hide** (level 4): +1 Armor, Armor max 6, reach 10 ft, counts as Huge. **Fortress** (level 7): allies near you take half Area damage, and once per round you take an ally's lethal hit.

| Stage | Name | Bio | Chrome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | **Juggernaut** | Thick neck, heavy brow, knuckles armoured with horn. Your skin has the give of a car tyre. | Subdermal plates you can feel through your shirt; a spine brace that whines when you stand. |
| Evolution I | **Rampart** | You grow a foot in a night. Your back splits into overlapping bone slabs; your forearms swell into shields. | Bulkhead plates bolt over shoulders and chest; your joints are hydraulic now, and they hiss. |
| Evolution II | **Colossus** | Nine feet of keratin and scar tissue. Horns, a domed skull, a heartbeat people feel through the floor. | A walking bunker: riveted armour, a face behind a visor slit, treads of steel on your soles. |
| Final | **Citadel** | Stone-hard ridges, moss in the cracks, small things nesting in you. You are a place. | Siren lights, warning stencils, a hatch in your chest. Ostrander would classify you as infrastructure. |

#### 2A.4.2 Skitter
**Primary Moxie · Secondary Gumption · Tertiary Grit · Dump Nerve and Chutzpah · Trees: Wiring (primary), Limbs (secondary), Senses (tertiary)**

*"You blinked. I was already there."* The Mutagen took your nerves and set them on fire. Skitters are the fastest thing in any room: clever with their hands, wiry, and impossible to pin down. They're also jumpy, tactless and short on Flux; their Nerve is the first thing to go.

- **Play it if** you want to dart in, Daze, dart out, and act more often than anyone else.
- **Evolution nodes:** **Mantis Reflex** (level 4): two Reactions per round, and full-damage Reflex Spikes. **Lightning Step** (level 7): a half-dice weapon attack as a Quick action after you Unleash.

| Stage | Name | Bio | Chrome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | **Skitter** | Long limbs, twitchy hands, pupils that never settle; you're warm to the touch. | Reflex jacks at the base of the skull; fingertips with steel contacts that spark when you're nervous. |
| Evolution I | **Mantis** | Your forearms fold into barbed hooks; your knees bend backwards; you smell like ozone. | Synthetic muscle cables under translucent skin, and a capacitor hump between your shoulders. |
| Evolution II | **Wraith** | Glassy wing-cases that hum, faceted eyes, lightning crawling along your veins. | You blur when you move; a plasma coil glows through your ribs; you leave scorch-prints. |
| Final | **Livewire** | Barely solid: a figure of arcs and chitin that's always slightly somewhere else. | A human-shaped storm in a chrome cage, held together by a magnetic field. |

#### 2A.4.3 Oracle
**Primary Nerve · Secondary Chutzpah · Tertiary Moxie · Dump Grit and Gumption · Trees: Senses (primary), Mind (secondary), Wiring (tertiary)**

*"I saw you coming. Three days ago."* The Mutagen gave you **too much input**, and you learned to stay calm inside it. Oracles see everything, steady everyone and hold the most Flux of any Form (their high Nerve raises their Flux Limit). They're light on their feet but physically fragile and impractical; their aim isn't.

- **Play it if** you want to shoot from a rooftop, spot every weakness, and decide which way the dice fall.
- **Evolution nodes:** **Foresight** (level 4): each round, an Omen d20 that can replace any nearby d20. **Thousand Eyes** (level 7): Target Lock on three creatures, no surprise or Blindness nearby, wider Crits.

| Stage | Name | Bio | Chrome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | **Oracle** | Pale, still, unsettling eyes with too much iris; you hear heartbeats through walls. | A monocle lens grafted to the socket; tiny antennae behind the ears. |
| Evolution I | **Argus** | A third eye opens on your brow; small eyes bead along your collarbones and blink out of time. | A ring of lenses around your head like a crown; your voice comes with a faint radio hiss. |
| Evolution II | **Seraph** | Wing-like membranes covered in eyes unfold from your back; you float a hand's width off the floor. | Six optic arms fan out from your spine; holographic targeting halos hang around you. |
| Final | **Panopticon** | A tall white shape of lids and lashes; when you look at someone, they feel *seen*. | A tower of lenses and dishes; every camera in the district turns toward you. |

#### 2A.4.4 Alembic
**Primary Gumption · Secondary Grit · Tertiary Nerve · Dump Moxie and Chutzpah · Trees: Glands (primary), Hide (secondary), Mind (tertiary)**

*"Hold still. This will either cure you or kill it."* The Mutagen made you a **laboratory**. Alembics brew medicine and poison in their own bodies, stay standing in toxic air, and keep the whole crew alive. They're slow, tough and steady-handed, with a bedside manner best described as *blunt*.

- **Play it if** you want to heal, poison, and out-think the problem.
- **Evolution nodes:** **Transmute** (level 4): your Toxin and Corrode riders apply both Poisoned and Exposed, and your healing restores more. **Panacea** (level 7): once per combat, heal everyone nearby and end their conditions.

| Stage | Name | Bio | Chrome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | **Alembic** | Glands swelling at the throat and wrists; you sweat something sweet-smelling and faintly green. | Injector ports along your forearms, and a hip-mounted reservoir with a gauge. |
| Evolution I | **Still** | Translucent sacs bloom across your back, glowing with what you're brewing; your breath fogs. | Coiled tubing and glass vials under a ribcage of chrome; you gurgle when you walk. |
| Evolution II | **Bloomheart** | Spore-fronds and flower-like vents open along your spine; insects follow you. | A walking refinery: pressurised tanks, nozzle arrays, a warning placard that reads FLAMMABLE. |
| Final | **Wellspring** | A living garden: roots in the floor where you stand, fruit that heals, pollen that kills. | A mobile clinic: hissing pipes, a dozen spigots, steam that smells like hospitals. |

#### 2A.4.5 Siren
**Primary Chutzpah · Secondary Moxie · Tertiary Gumption · Dump Grit and Nerve · Trees: Mind (primary), Wiring (secondary), Limbs (tertiary)**

*"Everybody look at me."* The Mutagen made you **impossible to ignore**. Sirens command attention: they talk past guards, Taunt whole rooms, and bend minds. They're quick enough to dodge the attention they draw and sharp enough to improvise, but fragile, reckless, and the first to Overload (their low Nerve means a low Flux Limit).

- **Play it if** you want to lead, talk, Taunt and control the battlefield.
- **Evolution nodes:** **Siren Song** (level 4): a Quick mass Taunt that sends every Taunted enemy at you or an ally you name (usually your Juggernaut), at −2 TN. **Crown of Will** (level 7): once per combat, a non-Boss fights for you.

| Stage | Name | Bio | Chrome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base | **Siren** | Striking face, a voice with a second note under it, a scent people remember. | Voice modulator at the throat; LED tattoos that pulse when you talk. |
| Evolution I | **Diva** | Iridescent skin, a frill of feathers or fins at the neck; your voice harmonises with itself. | Speaker grilles bloom along your collarbones; your face projects a light-show halo. |
| Evolution II | **Choir** | A crown of soft horns; a dozen mouths open along your arms and sing in chorus. | An antenna crown and a cape of fibre-optic cable; you broadcast on every frequency. |
| Final | **Crowned** | Too beautiful to look at directly; people weep, kneel or flee. | A living billboard and a broadcast tower; your face is on every screen, saying *your* name. |

## 3. Augment Trees

![Chrome freelancer](../art/char_chrome.jpg)

Your Augments are what you've done to your body. Your **Base Form** ([chapter 2A](#2a-base-forms--evolution)) decides which **three trees** you grow along: a **primary** tree you master, a **secondary** you lean on, and a **tertiary** you dabble in. There are six trees, and each one is a body system you've rebuilt. Each can be **grown (Bio)** or **installed (Chrome)**.

| Tree | Stat | Role | Unlocks | Primary of | Secondary of | Tertiary of |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [**Hide**](#36-hide--the-body-as-a-fortress) | Grit | Tank, protector | Pulse (Shape), Quake, Shell | Juggernaut | Alembic | — |
| [**Limbs**](#37-limbs--claws-legs-and-too-many-arms) | Grit / Moxie | Melee, grappler, mover | Wave (Shape), Snare | — | Juggernaut, Skitter | Siren |
| [**Senses**](#38-senses--eyes-everywhere) | Nerve | Sniper, scout, spotter | Glare, Veil | Oracle | — | Skitter |
| [**Glands**](#39-glands--the-walking-pharmacy) | Gumption | Chemist, healer, attrition | Burst (Shape), Toxin, Corrode, Mend | Alembic | — | Juggernaut |
| [**Wiring**](#310-wiring--faster-than-you-should-be) | Moxie | Speed, reflexes, shock | Shock, Blaze, Haste | Skitter | Siren | Oracle |
| [**Mind**](#311-mind--the-voice-in-every-head) | Chutzpah | Psionics, hacking, control | Dread, Link | Siren | Oracle | Alembic |

### 3.1 How Trees Work
- **Ten nodes per tree:** a **Root**, four **Tier I** nodes, four **Tier II** nodes, and an **Apex**. A Form's primary tree also holds that Form's two **Evolution nodes**.
- **You only take nodes from your Form's three trees.**
- **Gates:**

| Node | Needs |
|---|---|
| **Root** | Nothing. You take all three Roots at level 1. |
| **Tier I** | The tree's Root |
| **Tier II** | **Level 4+** and **3 nodes** already in that tree |
| **Apex** | **Level 7+**, **6 other nodes** in that tree, and it must be your **primary or secondary** tree |
| **Evolution node** | Your Form, at level 4 (Evolution I) or level 7 (Evolution II). Granted automatically. |

"Nodes in that tree" counts your standard nodes (Root, Tier I, Tier II); **Evolution nodes don't count toward a gate.**

- **Scaling.** Nodes scale with your **Rank**; you never need a "greater" version. A node is taken once.
- **Push.** Some nodes say **Push**: you may gain **1 Flux** to get the extra effect ([Chapter 5](#5-flux--overload)).
- **Unlocks.** Each tree unlocks **Surge parts** ([Chapter 4](#4-surges--the-sequence)) the moment you take its Root. Since you take all three Roots at level 1, your Form fixes your Surge parts.

### 3.2 Gaining Nodes

| When | Primary tree | Secondary or tertiary tree |
|---|---|---|
| **Level 1** | **3 nodes** (Root + 2) | **2 nodes** in the secondary (Root + 1) and **1 node** in the tertiary (its Root) |
| **Each level after** | **+1 node, automatically.** You always get it, and you choose which. | **+1 node** in your secondary **or** tertiary tree (your choice) |
| **Level 4 and 7** | **+ your Form's Evolution node** (on top of the pick) | — |

- **Primary tree full?** Its 10 standard nodes fill up at level 8. From level 9, the automatic primary pick **overflows** into your secondary or tertiary tree.
- **Totals:** 2 × level + 4 nodes, plus Evolution nodes: **6 at level 1, 13 at level 4, 20 at level 7, 26 at level 10.**
- **Respec.** When you level up, you may swap one node for another of the same pick type that you qualify for. The clinic rips it out.

### 3.3 Material: Bio or Chrome
When you take a tree's Root, choose its **Material**: grown or installed. Every node in that tree shares it. Material changes how the tree looks and adds the rules below. *(v0.1 called this "Form"; that word now means your Base Form.)*

| Material | Looks like | Perk | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Bio** (grown) | Chitin, scales, extra eyes, glands, tentacles, glowing veins | **Knit:** at the end of each combat, and when you take a Breather, regain HP equal to **Rank × your number of Bio trees**. | Your Overloads roll on the **Bloom** table. |
| **Chrome** (installed) | Plates, pistons, optics, ports, wiring, servo-arms | **Firmware:** once per combat, right after you Prime, you may swap one Primed Surge for any Surge you know that uses a part unlocked by one of your Chrome trees (base parts alone don't count). | Your Overloads roll on the **Glitch** table. You roll defense with **disadvantage against Shock** attacks. **Upkeep:** 25 Scrip per Chrome tree each mission (GRAFT prepays your first), or start the mission with +1 Flux per unpaid tree. |
| **Splice** (you have both) | Meat and metal fighting for the same body | Overload: roll on **both** tables, then choose one result. Each tree keeps its own Material rules. | Your Flux Limit is **−1** (after the minimum of 4). |

Your Evolutions follow your Materials: a Bio Juggernaut's Rampart stage grows bone slabs, a Chrome one bolts on bulkheads.

### 3.4 The Evolution Nodes at a Glance

| Form | Primary tree | Level 4: Evolution I | Level 7: Evolution II |
|---|---|---|---|
| Juggernaut | Hide | **Siege Hide:** +1 Armor, Armor max 6, reach 10 ft, counts as Huge | **Fortress:** allies within 10 ft take half Area damage; take an ally's lethal hit |
| Skitter | Wiring | **Mantis Reflex:** two Reactions per round; Reflex Spike and Opportunity Strikes use full dice | **Lightning Step:** after you Unleash, a half-dice weapon attack as a Quick action |
| Oracle | Senses | **Foresight:** each round, an Omen d20 that can replace any nearby d20 | **Thousand Eyes:** Target Lock ×3, no surprise or Blindness nearby, wider Crits |
| Alembic | Glands | **Transmute:** Toxin/Corrode riders apply Poisoned *and* Exposed; healing +Gumption | **Panacea:** once per combat, heal the whole party and end their conditions |
| Siren | Mind | **Siren Song:** a Quick mass Taunt that sends enemies at you or an ally you name, at −2 TN | **Crown of Will:** once per combat, a non-Boss fights for you |

### 3.5 Building With Trees
Your Form decides your trees, but which nodes you take decides your role.

| Form | Leans toward… | …or toward |
|---|---|---|
| **Juggernaut** | Doorway-holder: Plating, Menace, Living Wall, Bulwark | Brawler: Limbs Crusher Grip, Rend, Flurry |
| **Skitter** | Duelist: Capacitor, Reflex Spike, Kinetic Battery | Runner and skirmisher: Slipstream, Arc Jump, Spring Legs, Pounce |
| **Oracle** | Sniper: Target Lock, Long Sight, Deadeye | Spotter: Analyzer, Weak Spot, Spotter, Precog |
| **Alembic** | Medic: Stim Gland, Antibodies, Living Pharmacy | Poisoner: Spit, Catalyst, Spore Cloud, Burst Surges |
| **Siren** | Commander: Commanding Voice, Hive Mind, Haste Surges | Controller: Puppet, Psychic Scream, Snare Waves |

### 3.6 Hide — the body as a fortress

*Bio: chitin plates, scales, rubbery blubber, bark-skin. Chrome: dermal plating, kinetic mesh, ablative shell.*

**Stat:** Grit · **Role:** tank, protector · **Unlocks:** Pulse (Shape), Quake, Shell · **Primary tree of:** Juggernaut · **Secondary of:** Alembic

#### 3.6.1 Root
- **Plating.** +1 Armor (**+2 from Rank 3**). Armor from all sources maxes at 4, unless a node says otherwise.

#### 3.6.2 Tier I (needs the Root)
- **Thick.** +2 Max HP per level (count past levels too).
- **Barbs.** When an enemy's melee attack damages you, it takes **2 × Rank** damage.
- **Anchor.** You can't be knocked Prone, pushed or pulled against your will. You roll defense with advantage against attacks whose rider is Held.
- **Shoulder Check.** Once per turn, you can Grapple or Shove as a Quick action.

#### 3.6.3 Tier II (needs level 4+ and 3 nodes in this tree)
- **Adaptive.** When you take Blaze, Shock, Toxin, Corrode or Psychic damage, you resist that type (half damage) until combat ends. One type at a time; a new type replaces the old.
- **Bulwark.** *Reaction:* when an ally within 10 ft is targeted by a Single attack, you become the target instead and roll your own defense. **Push:** roll it with advantage.
- **Living Wall.** Allies adjacent to you get **+1** to defense rolls (**+2 from Rank 4**). It doesn't stack with another Living Wall.
- **Menace.** You can Taunt as a Quick action, using Grit in place of Chutzpah. You get **+2** to defense rolls against creatures you have Taunted.

#### 3.6.4 Apex (needs level 7+, 6 other nodes in this tree, and this must be your primary or secondary tree)
- **Unbreakable.** Once per round, when you fail a defense roll, **Push** to take half damage and ignore its rider. Your Armor maximum is 5.

#### 3.6.5 Evolution nodes (Juggernaut only; granted automatically)
- **Siege Hide** *(level 4, Evolution I).* Your hide thickens into overlapping slabs. +1 Armor, and your Armor maximum is **6**. Your melee reach is 10 ft, and you count as **Huge** (non-Huge creatures can't knock you Prone or push you).
- **Fortress** *(level 7, Evolution II).* You are terrain now. Allies within 10 ft of you take **half damage from Area attacks** (after their own defense roll). *Reaction:* once per round, when an ally within 30 ft would drop to 0 HP, you take that damage instead (your Armor applies).

### 3.7 Limbs — claws, legs, and too many arms

*Bio: claws, mantis blades, tentacles, extra arms, digitigrade legs. Chrome: piston arms, mono-blades, grapple lines, servo-arms, hydraulic legs.*

**Stat:** Grit or Moxie · **Role:** melee, grappler, mover · **Unlocks:** Wave (Shape), Snare · **Secondary tree of:** Juggernaut, Skitter · **Tertiary of:** Siren

Limbs is the **shared body tree**. It is never a Form's primary tree, so it has no Evolution nodes. Its Apex is open to the Juggernaut and the Skitter, who have it as their secondary tree.

#### 3.7.1 Root
- **Natural Weapons.** Claws, blades or pistons: a melee weapon (**d8**, Grit or Moxie) that can't be disarmed and doesn't need a free hand.

#### 3.7.2 Tier I (needs the Root)
- **Extra Arm.** A third limb. Hold one more item, and draw, stow or interact without using your Quick action. Once per turn, when you hit with a melee attack, deal **+1 damage die** (one more of that attack's dice). **Push:** also knock the target Prone (not Huge).
- **Grapnel.** Your melee reach is 10 ft. As your Move, you can pull yourself up to 30 ft to any surface you can see, or yank an unheld object to your hand.
- **Spring Legs.** +10 ft speed. Jump 20 ft long or 10 ft high as part of your move, climb at full speed, and take half falling damage.
- **Lash Tail.** You can make an Opportunity Strike when an enemy **enters** your melee reach, as well as when it leaves. A hit from an Opportunity Strike knocks a non-Huge target Prone.

#### 3.7.3 Tier II (needs level 4+ and 3 nodes in this tree)
- **Crusher Grip.** Once per turn when you hit with a natural weapon, the target is **Held**. Huge creatures and Bosses require a **Push**.
- **Rend.** Your natural weapons' die becomes **d10** (**d12 from Rank 4**).
- **Pounce.** Once per turn, if you move at least 15 ft toward a creature and then hit it with a melee attack, it's knocked Prone (not Huge), and you can Grapple it as a Quick action.
- **Many Hands.** Help is a Quick action for you. You can hold a second creature Held while you already hold one.

#### 3.7.4 Apex (needs level 7+, 6 other nodes in this tree, and this must be your primary or secondary tree)
- **Flurry.** When you take the Attack action with natural weapons, make a second attack with half the damage dice (round up).

### 3.8 Senses — eyes everywhere

*Bio: compound eyes, pit organs, bat ears, whiskers, a third eye. Chrome: optic suites, targeting HUD, radar, audio filters.*

**Stat:** Nerve · **Role:** sniper, scout, spotter · **Unlocks:** Glare, Veil · **Primary tree of:** Oracle · **Tertiary of:** Skitter

#### 3.8.1 Root
- **Keen.** See in darkness out to 60 ft. Advantage on checks to notice hidden things. Bright light can't Blind you.

#### 3.8.2 Tier I (needs the Root)
- **Target Lock.** *Quick:* mark a creature you can see. Once per turn, your attack against it deals **+1 damage die** (one more of that attack's dice). The mark lasts until combat ends or you mark another.
- **Threat Sense.** You and your group can't be surprised. *Reaction:* when an ally within 30 ft makes a defense roll, add your Nerve to it (declare before rolling).
- **Analyzer.** You can **Analyze** as a Quick action once per turn.
- **Echolocation.** You sense creatures within 30 ft without sight. You can't be Blinded against anything within that range, and hidden or invisible creatures there are revealed to you.

#### 3.8.3 Tier II (needs level 4+ and 3 nodes in this tree)
- **Long Sight.** Double the range of your ranged attacks and ranged Surges. Ignore partial cover. Read lips at 300 ft.
- **Weak Spot.** When you Analyze a creature, its Armor and Resistances don't apply to anyone's damage until the end of its next turn.
- **Spotter.** *Quick,* once per round: an ally within 60 ft who can hear you gets advantage on its next attack against a creature you can see.
- **Hair Trigger.** When a combat starts, after Priming and before anyone else acts, you may make one ranged weapon attack.

#### 3.8.4 Apex (needs level 7+, 6 other nodes in this tree, and this must be your primary or secondary tree)
- **Deadeye.** Your ranged attacks (weapons, Spit, Mind Spike, ranged Surges) Crit on 18–20. Once per round, **Push** to reroll a missed attack.

#### 3.8.5 Evolution nodes (Oracle only; granted automatically)
- **Foresight** *(level 4, Evolution I).* A lidless third eye opens. At the start of each round, roll a d20 and set it aside: your **Omen**. Once before the round ends, after any d20 is rolled by you or an ally within 60 ft, you may replace that roll with the Omen. An unused Omen fades at the end of the round.
- **Thousand Eyes** *(level 7, Evolution II).* Eyes open all over you. Target Lock can mark up to **three** creatures at once. You and allies within 60 ft can't be surprised or Blinded. Your ranged attacks ignore partial cover, and their Crit range is one wider than it would otherwise be: 20 → 19–20, 19–20 → 18–20, 18–20 → 17–20. This is an exception to the rule that Crit ranges don't stack.

### 3.9 Glands — the walking pharmacy

*Bio: venom sacs, acid glands, healing bile, spore pods. Chrome: chem injectors, nanite reservoirs, drug pumps, nozzle ports.*

**Stat:** Gumption · **Role:** chemist, healer, attrition · **Unlocks:** Burst (Shape), Toxin, Corrode, Mend · **Primary tree of:** Alembic · **Tertiary of:** Juggernaut

#### 3.9.1 Root
- **Spit.** A ranged natural attack (**d8**, 30 ft, Nerve or Gumption) dealing Toxin or Corrode damage (choose each time). Advantage on Endure against poison.

#### 3.9.2 Tier I (needs the Root)
- **Regenerate.** At the start of your turn, if you're at half HP or less (and not Down), regain **Rank + 1** HP.
- **Stim Gland.** *Action* (or *Quick* with **Push**): you or a creature you touch regains **Rank d6 + Gumption** HP and ends Burning or Poisoned. Twice per Breather.
- **Adrenal Dump.** The first time each combat you drop to half HP or less, gain **2 × Rank + Grit** temporary HP and advantage on your next attack.
- **Antibodies.** You can't be Poisoned. *Quick,* once per Breather: end one condition on a creature you touch.

#### 3.9.3 Tier II (needs level 4+ and 3 nodes in this tree)
- **Purge.** Once per combat, *Quick:* lose Flux equal to **Rank + 1** and take that much damage (ignores Armor).
- **Catalyst.** Your Burst Surges roll **d8** damage dice instead of d6.
- **Spore Cloud.** *Action,* once per combat, **Push:** exhale a 15-ft-radius cloud centred on you that lasts until the end of next round. Creatures outside it can't see into it. You and your allies inside are Veiled against attacks made from outside the cloud.
- **Mutagen Tap.** Once per round, when you would gain Flux, you may take **Rank + 1** damage per point instead (ignores Armor; it can't drop you below 1 HP).

#### 3.9.4 Apex (needs level 7+, 6 other nodes in this tree, and this must be your primary or secondary tree)
- **Living Pharmacy.** Stim Gland affects you and every ally within 15 ft at once. Your Mend Surges cost no Flux.

#### 3.9.5 Evolution nodes (Alembic only; granted automatically)
- **Transmute** *(level 4, Evolution I).* Your glands learn to brew anything. When your Toxin or Corrode damage applies its rider, the target is both **Poisoned and Exposed**. Your healing (Stim Gland, Mend Surges, Patch) restores **+Gumption** HP.
- **Panacea** *(level 7, Evolution II).* Your blood is medicine. Once per combat, *Action:* you and every ally within 30 ft regain **(Rank + 1)d8 + Gumption** HP, end all conditions, and lose 2 Flux. A Down ally stands up.

### 3.10 Wiring — faster than you should be

*Bio: hyper-fast nerves, eel-organs, adrenal crystals. Chrome: reflex boosters, synthetic muscle, capacitor banks, plasma coils.*

**Stat:** Moxie · **Role:** speed, reflexes, shock · **Unlocks:** Shock, Blaze, Haste · **Primary tree of:** Skitter · **Secondary of:** Siren · **Tertiary of:** Oracle

#### 3.10.1 Root
- **Quickened.** +10 ft speed. You can **Dash** as a Quick action. Your group has advantage on initiative checks.

#### 3.10.2 Tier I (needs the Root)
- **Reflex Spike.** *Reaction,* **Push:** when you succeed on a Dodge against a melee attack, make one weapon attack against the attacker with half the damage dice (round up).
- **Capacitor.** Once per turn when you hit with a melee attack, deal **+1 damage die** (one more of that attack's dice) as Shock. **Push:** the target is also Dazed.
- **Slipstream.** You never provoke Opportunity Strikes, can move through enemies' spaces, and take **no** damage when you succeed on a Dodge against an Area attack.
- **Wall Run.** As part of your Move you can run along walls and across liquids, as long as you end the Move on something that holds you (otherwise you fall).

#### 3.10.3 Tier II (needs level 4+ and 3 nodes in this tree)
- **Overclock.** Once per Breather, take one extra Action on your turn, then gain 1 Flux.
- **Arc Jump.** Once per turn, as part of your Move, flash up to 20 ft in a straight line, passing through creatures' spaces. **Push:** each creature you pass through takes **2 × Rank** Shock damage.
- **Kinetic Battery.** Each time you succeed on a Dodge, store a charge (max 3). When you hit with an attack, you may spend all your charges: **+1 damage die per charge**, as Shock. Charges fade when combat ends.
- **Afterimage.** When you Dash, you are Veiled until the start of your next turn.

#### 3.10.4 Apex (needs level 7+, 6 other nodes in this tree, and this must be your primary or secondary tree)
- **Blur.** You get two Moves each turn. If you've moved 20+ ft this turn, roll your first Dodge each round with advantage until your next turn.

#### 3.10.5 Evolution nodes (Skitter only; granted automatically)
- **Mantis Reflex** *(level 4, Evolution I).* Your nerves fire before you think. You get **two Reactions** per round (both refresh at the start of your turn). Your Reflex Spike and Opportunity Strikes use your full damage dice.
- **Lightning Step** *(level 7, Evolution II).* You move between moments. Once per turn, after you Unleash a Surge, you may make **one weapon attack as a Quick action**, with half its damage dice (round up).

### 3.11 Mind — the voice in every head

*Bio: swollen cortex, psionic nodules, pheromone glands, a voice that echoes. Chrome: neural coprocessor, wetware deck, voice modulator, antenna crown.*

**Stat:** Chutzpah · **Role:** psionics, hacking, control, leadership · **Unlocks:** Dread, Link · **Primary tree of:** Siren · **Secondary of:** Oracle · **Tertiary of:** Alembic

#### 3.11.1 Root
- **Uplink.** Speak mind-to-mind (Bio) or by encrypted radio (Chrome) with willing creatures within 300 ft. **Mind Spike:** a ranged attack (**d8**, 60 ft, Nerve or Chutzpah) dealing Psychic damage.

#### 3.11.2 Tier I (needs the Root)
- **Intrude.** *Action:* Gumption or Chutzpah + Rank vs a creature's TN (or a device's DC). Read its surface thoughts, or seize an unattended device for 1 minute. In combat, a Mook machine obeys you until the end of next round; any other machine is Dazed.
- **Iron Will.** Advantage on Resist, and you can't be Shaken. Allies within 30 ft get +1 to Resist.
- **Commanding Voice.** You can **Rally** as a Quick action.
- **Read the Room.** Advantage on checks to spot a lie. Once per scene, ask the GM what a creature you can see wants or fears most right now; the answer is true.

#### 3.11.3 Tier II (needs level 4+ and 3 nodes in this tree)
- **Puppet.** *Action,* **Push:** Chutzpah + Rank vs the TN of a non-Boss creature. On a success, it immediately does one of these, your choice: moves up to its speed where you choose, or makes one attack against a target you choose. An enemy target simply takes the attack's Damage (no roll, no rider); a player target defends normally.
- **Precog.** *Reaction,* **Push:** when you or an ally within 30 ft is about to make a d20 roll (declare before rolling), they roll it with advantage.
- **Psychic Scream.** *Action,* once per combat: make one Chutzpah attack (an **Area** attack) against every enemy within 30 ft that you choose. Hit: **(Rank + 1)d6** Psychic and Shaken. Miss: half damage.
- **Glamour.** *Quick,* **Push:** you are Veiled until the end of next round.

#### 3.11.4 Apex (needs level 7+, 6 other nodes in this tree, and this must be your primary or secondary tree)
- **Hive Mind.** Once per round, an ally within 300 ft can use your Nerve or Chutzpah in place of theirs for one roll. At the start of each combat, choose one ally: they Prime one extra Surge.

#### 3.11.5 Evolution nodes (Siren only; granted automatically)
- **Siren Song** *(level 4, Evolution I).* Your voice splits into harmonies. Once per round you can Taunt as a Quick action, and your Taunt can target every enemy within 30 ft you choose (compare one roll to each creature's TN). Each enemy you Taunt this way must target **you or one ally you name** within 30 ft of you (same ally for all of them) if it can, and has **−2 TN** against that creature's defense rolls until the Taunt ends.
- **Crown of Will** *(level 7, Evolution II).* Once per combat, *Action,* **Push:** Chutzpah + Rank vs the TN of a creature within 60 ft. A **non-Boss** obeys you until the end of combat. In each Enemy Phase it acts as you choose (it won't harm itself), and it breaks free if you or an ally damages it. A **Boss** instead loses its next Interrupt and is Dazed until the end of its next turn.

## 4. Surges & the Sequence

![A Surge](../art/surge.jpg)

Mutagen doesn't take orders well. In a fight, your body offers you a few of its powers at random: a spurt of acid, a crackle of arc-light, a shell that snaps shut. These are **Surges**. They are **optional**. Your weapons and Augments always work; Surges are the big, unreliable spikes on top.

### 4.1 The Short Version
1. You **build** Surges from parts and write them on your **Sequence** (a numbered list).
2. At the start of each fight you **Prime**: roll your **Sequence die** a few times. The Surges you roll are ready.
3. On your turn you may **Unleash** a Primed Surge as your Action. It costs **Flux**.
4. Want more options? **Churn** as a Quick action to roll again.
5. From your first **Evolution** (level 4) you also have **Signature Surges** that are always ready ([below](#47-signature-surges)).

---

### 4.2 Building a Surge
A Surge = **one Shape + one Effect** (+ optional **Twist**). Name it and describe what it looks like. *Bolt + Corrode* might be "Acid Spit" for a Bio freelancer or "Etching Laser" for a Chrome one.

You can use any **base** part, plus parts **unlocked** by trees you have the Root of.

#### 4.2.1 Shapes (how it's delivered)

| Shape | Unlock | Target | Attack stat | Damage on hit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Strike** | base | One creature in melee reach | Grit or Moxie | (Rank+1)**d10** + stat |
| **Bolt** | base | One creature within 60 ft | Nerve | (Rank+1)**d8** + stat |
| **Burst** | Glands | Everything in a 10-ft radius within 60 ft | Nerve | (Rank+1)**d6** |
| **Wave** | Limbs | 15-ft cone or 30-ft line from you | Grit or Nerve | (Rank+1)**d6** |
| **Pulse** | Hide | Any creatures you choose within 10 ft of you | Grit | (Rank+1)**d6** |
| **Infuse** | base | You or one ally within 30 ft | — (no roll) | Uses an Infuse Effect |

**Area Shapes** (Burst, Wave, Pulse): roll one attack and compare it to each target's Guard. **Hit:** full damage + Effect. **Miss:** half damage, no Effect. Allies in a Burst or Wave are hit too (they roll Dodge against your attack total; success = half damage, no rider); a Pulse hits only the creatures you choose. Footprints on a grid (a 10-ft radius is 5×5 squares, a 15-ft cone is 3 squares deep) are in [Combat](#642-areas-both-ways).

**Attack stat.** A Surge uses its Shape's attack stat, **or** the stat of the tree that unlocked its Effect, whichever you prefer:

| Effect's tree | Hide | Limbs | Senses | Glands | Wiring | Mind |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stat it allows | Grit | Grit or Moxie | Nerve | Gumption | Moxie | Chutzpah |

*Bolt + Shock* can use Nerve (Bolt) or Moxie (Wiring); *Burst + Toxin* can use Nerve or Gumption (Glands); *Wave + Dread* can use Grit, Nerve or Chutzpah (Mind). Base Effects (Kinetic) use the Shape's stat only.

#### 4.2.2 Effects (what it does)
**Damage Effects** go with Strike, Bolt, Burst, Wave, or Pulse. The rider applies on a hit (conditions are in [Combat](#68-conditions)).

| Effect | Unlock | Damage type | Rider on hit |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Kinetic** | base | Kinetic | +1 damage die, and you may push the target 10 ft |
| **Blaze** | Wiring | Blaze | Burning |
| **Shock** | Wiring | Shock | Dazed |
| **Toxin** | Glands | Toxin | Poisoned |
| **Corrode** | Glands | Corrode | Exposed |
| **Snare** | Limbs | Kinetic | Held |
| **Quake** | Hide | Kinetic | Prone (not Huge) |
| **Glare** | Senses | Blaze | Blinded |
| **Dread** | Mind | Psychic | Shaken |

**Infuse Effects** go only with Infuse. No roll, no miss.

| Effect | Unlock | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| **Mend** | Glands | Target regains (Rank+1)d8 + Gumption HP and ends Burning and Poisoned. A Down target stands up. |
| **Shell** | Hide | Target gains (Rank+1)d6 + Grit temporary HP and +1 Armor until the end of next round. |
| **Haste** | Wiring | An **ally** (not you) immediately takes a Move and one Action (not Unleash), with advantage on any roll that Action needs. |
| **Veil** | Senses | Target is **Veiled** until the end of next round: advantage on defense rolls and on its next attack. |
| **Link** | Mind | Target and up to Rank other allies within 30 ft get advantage on their next d20 roll before the end of next round. |

#### 4.2.3 Twists (optional, +1 Flux each)
A Surge can carry **one Twist** (two **different** Twists from Rank 3). Each Twist adds **+1 Flux** to its cost. Twists are always available.

| Twist | Works with | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| **Chain** | Strike, Bolt | After resolving, repeat it against a second target within 15 ft of the first for half damage. |
| **Linger** | Burst, Wave, Pulse | The area stays until the end of next round. An enemy that enters it or starts its turn there takes 2 × Rank damage and the rider (no roll). |
| **Leech** | Any damage | Regain HP equal to half the damage dealt to one target. |
| **Overcharge** | Any damage | +2 damage dice. |
| **Sure** | Any | Roll the attack with advantage, or Infuse one extra ally. |
| **Reach** | Any | Double range or area size. Strike reaches 15 ft. |
| **Hush** | Any | Silent and invisible in origin; using it doesn't reveal you or break stealth. |

> **Budget check.** A plain weapon hit at level 1 averages ~7.5 damage (1d8 + 3). A Bolt Surge averages ~12 *and* applies a condition. At level 7 (Rank 4, primary +8) a weapon hit is ~26 and a Bolt Surge ~30.5 plus a rider. That's the trade: Surges are stronger, but you don't choose which ones you get (except your Signatures), and each one pushes you toward Overload.

---

### 4.3 The Sequence
Your **Sequence** is a numbered list of your Surges. Its size is your **Sequence die**. The die only grows twice after level 2, when you **Evolve**:

| Level | 1 | 2–3 | 4–6 (Evolution I) | 7–10 (Evolution II) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Sequence die** | d4 | d6 | **d8** | **d12** |
| **Surges known** | level + 2 (3 at level 1, 12 at level 10) ||||
| **Prime** | 2 | 2 | **3** | **4** |
| **Signature Surges** | — | — | **1** | **2** |
| **Wild slots** | 1 | 2, then 1 | 2, 1, 0 | 3, 2, 1, 0 |

Write your Surges in slots 1, 2, 3... Any slot without a Surge is **Wild** (see below). Right after each Evolution your new body offers powers you don't understand yet (extra Wild slots). Then you fill them in, one per level, until your Sequence is full at levels 6 and 10.

You can leave a slot Wild on purpose. When you gain a level, you may **rewrite** one known Surge into a different build.

### 4.4 Priming
At the start of each combat (after initiative), each freelancer rolls their **Sequence die** once per point of **Prime**. Each result's Surge is **Primed**: ready to Unleash this fight. Mark them.

- **Doubles:** if two dice show the same Surge, it is Primed once and **Amped**: it costs **0 Flux** when Unleashed.
- **Wild:** if a die shows a Wild slot, roll on the **Wild Surge table** right away. That result is Primed. Each Wild die rolls separately; Wild results never count as doubles.
- **Juice:** spend 1 Juice to set one Sequence die to any result before you check for doubles.
- **Chrome Firmware** (see [Augment Trees](#3-augment-trees)) lets you swap one Primed Surge after rolling.

Unused Primed Surges fade when combat ends.

### 4.5 Unleashing
**Unleash** is an Action. Choose a Primed Surge, pay its **Flux** (1 + 1 per Twist; 0 if Amped), and resolve it. It is no longer Primed.

**Missed?** If a Strike or Bolt Surge misses, the Flux is still paid but the Surge **stays Primed** (still Amped, if it was). Your body tried; it'll try again.

### 4.6 Churning
**Churn** is a Quick action: gain **1 Flux** and roll your Sequence die once; that Surge is Primed (doubles with an already Primed Surge make it Amped). You **can't Churn on a turn you Unleash** (before or after); a Misfire's free Churn is the only exception. You can't hold more Primed Surges than **Prime + 1** (Signature Surges don't count); if you would, choose which to drop.

### 4.7 Signature Surges
At **Evolution I** (level 4) you gain one **Signature Surge**, and at **Evolution II** (level 7) a second. These are the powers your evolved body was built around.
- **Build** each from your parts like any Surge, with the Twists your Rank allows, and write it in a **Signature box**, not on the Sequence. It doesn't count toward Surges known, Prime, or the Primed maximum.
- **Always ready:** it's Primed at the start of every combat. When you Unleash it, it is Primed again at the start of your next turn, so you can Unleash each Signature **once per round**.
- **Cost:** its normal Flux (1 + 1 per Twist). Doubles can't Amp it. Only [Emergence](#2a32-emergence-the-moment-it-happens) (its first use) and Final Form make it free. Firmware can't swap it.
- **Missed** Strike or Bolt Signatures are simply ready again next turn.
- When you level up (from level 5), you may **rebuild** one Signature Surge.

> **Why it's fair:** you still get one Action a turn, and every Unleash costs Flux. A freelancer who Unleashes a Signature every round Overloads about once every two fights, unless they have a high Flux Limit (Oracles) or take a turn off to swing a weapon.

### 4.8 Surges Outside Combat
In any tense scene where the GM calls for initiative-style timing (a chase, a heist gone loud), Surges work the same way. In calm scenes you can't Prime; the Mutagen only answers when you're afraid.

---

### 4.9 Wild Surge Table (d12)
When a Wild slot is Primed, roll here. Unless it says otherwise, it costs 1 Flux to Unleash like any Surge.

| d12 | Wild Surge |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Misfire.** Your body sputters. This slot isn't Primed; instead, immediately Churn once for free (no Flux, no action). |
| 2 | **Spore Bloom.** Burst + Toxin with +2 dice, centred on **you** (you're unaffected). Allies in it roll Dodge. |
| 3 | **Arc Storm.** Bolt + Shock that hits up to three targets at full damage. You are Dazed afterward. |
| 4 | **Hardening.** Shell on you and every ally within 10 ft. Your speed is 0 until your next turn. |
| 5 | **Blood Price.** Strike + Kinetic with +2 more dice. You take Rank d6 damage (ignores Armor). |
| 6 | **Echo.** Unleash a copy of any Surge an ally currently has Primed (it stays Primed for them). |
| 7 | **Mitosis.** A shuddering copy of you appears adjacent. It acts on your turn (Move + one weapon attack, using your numbers). When an enemy attacks it, you roll Dodge for it; any failure destroys it. It melts at the end of combat. |
| 8 | **Phase Step.** Teleport up to 60 ft, then Strike + Kinetic a creature next to you. |
| 9 | **Gravity Knot.** Burst with both Quake and Snare riders. |
| 10 | **Feedback.** Pulse + Dread with a 20-ft radius. Costs 2 Flux. |
| 11 | **Flush.** Costs 0 Flux. Set your Flux to 0 and regain Rank d8 HP. |
| 12 | **Perfect Expression.** Unleash it as a Quick action for 0 Flux: Prime any two of your Surges as Amped (this can exceed your Primed maximum). |

---

Steal these, rename them, or build your own.

| Name | Build | Flux | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mantis Lunge | Strike + Kinetic | 1 | The default "hit it really hard" |
| Acid Spit | Bolt + Corrode | 1 | Opens a target up for the whole team |
