| Siren | **Commander** | Uplink, Commanding Voice, Iron Will · Quickened, Slipstream · Natural Weapons | Read the Room, Intrude, Puppet · Wall Run, Spring Legs, Afterimage | *Go, Go!* Infuse + Haste | Face |
| Siren | **Controller** | Uplink, Intrude, Commanding Voice · Quickened, Capacitor · Natural Weapons | Iron Will, Read the Room, Psychic Scream · Slipstream, Spring Legs, Overclock | *The Broadcast* Wave + Dread (Chutzpah) | Face |

### 13.5 Common Mistakes
- **Taking a node outside your Form's trees.** You only have three.
- **Wrong split at level 1.** It's 3 primary / 2 secondary / 1 tertiary, Roots first.
- **Skipping the primary pick.** You get one every level until the tree is full (level 8), and must take it.
- **Tier II before level 4**, or with fewer than 3 nodes in that tree.
- **An Apex in your tertiary tree**, before level 7, or with fewer than 6 other nodes in the tree.
- **Choosing your Evolution node.** It's fixed by your Form and comes free at 4 and 7.
- **Forgetting to recalculate at an Evolution:** HP (Grit), Limit (Nerve), every attack and Surge line.
- **Writing a Signature on your Sequence.** It goes in its own box and doesn't count toward Surges known.
- **Using a part you haven't unlocked.** Only base parts (Strike, Bolt, Infuse, Kinetic) and your Roots' unlocks.
- **Infuse with a damage Effect**, or Bolt with Mend. Infuse only takes Infuse Effects.
- **Wrong Twist:** Chain on a Burst, Linger on a Bolt, Overcharge on Infuse, two Twists before Rank 3, the same Twist twice.
- **Adding the stat to area damage.** Burst, Wave and Pulse roll dice only.
- **Forgetting Splice −1 Limit** or **Chrome Upkeep** (and disadvantage vs Shock).
- **Armor over the cap,** or wearing Light and Heavy together.
- **Knowing too many Surges.** Surges known = level + 2 (Lab Escapee +1, Samples extra); the rest are Wild, on purpose.

### 13.6 Worked Example: Dree "Brownout" Ocampo (Siren)

#### 13.6.1 Level 1 — Siren
1. **Concept:** Ex-Ward electrician who wired her voice into the power grid. She's a pirate-radio preacher of the blackout who can't stop broadcasting.
2. **Form:** **Siren** (Chutzpah primary; Mind / Wiring / Limbs).
3. **Stats:** Chutzpah +3, Moxie +2, Gumption +1 (set by the Form). She puts **Nerve +0**, **Grit −1** (she's skinny, but steady around live wires).
4. **Origin:** Ward Militia: *Squad Tactics*; +2 on group initiative, Brace as Quick once per combat.
5. **Knacks:** *Squad Tactics*, *Electrical Repair*, *Rooftop Routes*.
6. **Augments (6):**
   - Mind (**Bio**): *Uplink* (Root), *Intrude*, *Commanding Voice*.
   - Wiring (**Chrome**): *Quickened* (Root), *Slipstream*.
   - Limbs (**Bio**): *Natural Weapons* (Root).

   She has both Materials, so she is a **Splice**. Unlocked: Dread, Link, Shock, Blaze, Haste, Wave, Snare.
7. **Sequence (d4, Prime 2):**

| # | Surge | Build | Flux | At level 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sizzle Line | Wave + Blaze (30-ft line; Moxie via Wiring) | 1 | +3 vs each Guard, 2d6 Blaze, Burning |
| 2 | Brownout | Bolt + Shock (Moxie via Wiring) | 1 | +3, 2d8+2 Shock, Dazed |
| 3 | Dead Air | Bolt + Dread (Chutzpah via Mind) | 1 | +4, 2d8+3 Psychic, Shaken |
| 4 | *Wild* | | | |

   Firmware can swap in *Sizzle Line* or *Brownout* (they use Blaze/Shock from her Chrome Wiring); *Dead Air* uses only Bio Mind parts, so it can't be swapped in.

8. **Gear:** Face kit (Concealed Pistol, Light melee, Hack deck, Flashbang, +50 Scrip) + common items. 100 Scrip; buys a Medkit (25), 75 left. Upkeep 25 for Wiring, prepaid for mission 1.
9. **Numbers:** Rank 1 · HP **10** · Armor **1** · Speed **40** · Dodge **+3**, Endure **+0**, Resist **+1** · Flux Limit **4** (4 + 1 + 0 = 5, −1 Splice) · Knit 2 · Juice 1.
   **Attacks:** Mind Spike +4, 1d8+3 Psychic (60 ft) · Claws +3, 1d8+2 · Knife +3, 1d6+2 · Pistol +1, 1d6.
   **Material:** Knit 2 HP (2 Bio trees × Rank 1); Firmware; Overload rolls both tables; disadvantage vs Shock.
10. **Drive:** She took the Mutagen to survive a substation fire. She wants the Ward's grid back on. She owes Scrapjack boss **Tallow** a new spine.

*Playing her at level 1:* her Limit of 4 is tiny, so two Surges and a Churn is an Overload. Lead with *Dead Air*, keep Commanding Voice (Quick Rally, +4 temporary HP to everyone) for the bad round, and stay behind the Juggernaut.

#### 13.6.2 Level 4 — Evolution I: Diva
Level-ups: **2** *Iron Will* · *Wall Run* · Surge *Wire Up* (Infuse + Haste). **3** *Read the Room* · *Spring Legs* · Surge *Static Snare* (Wave + Snare) · Knack *Pirate Radio*. **4** *Psychic Scream* (Tier II) · *Overclock* (Tier II; Wiring has 3 nodes) · Surge *Overvolt* (Bolt + Shock + Overcharge) · **Evolution I**.
- **Look (Splice Diva):** iridescent skin and a frill of fins at the neck (Bio Mind); speaker grilles bloom along her collarbones and hum with mains current (Chrome Wiring).
- **Stats:** Chutzpah **+5**, Moxie +3, Gumption +2, Nerve +1, Grit +0. **Rank 2.**
- **Nodes (13):**
  - Mind (Bio): Uplink, Intrude, Commanding Voice, Iron Will, Read the Room, Psychic Scream, plus the Evolution node **Siren Song**.
  - Wiring (Chrome): Quickened, Slipstream, Wall Run, Overclock.
  - Limbs (Bio): Natural Weapons, Spring Legs.
- **Numbers:** HP **27** (12 + 0 + 15) · Armor 1 · Speed **50** · Dodge **+5**, Endure **+2**, Resist **+3** (advantage; can't be Shaken) · Flux Limit **6** (4 + 2 + 1 − 1) · Knit 4 · Prime **3** · Sequence **d8**.
- **Attacks:** Mind Spike +7, 2d8+5 Psychic · Claws +5, 2d8+3.
- **Signature Surge:** ***The Broadcast*** (Wave + Dread, Chutzpah): +7 vs each Guard in a 15-ft cone or 30-ft line, 3d6 Psychic, Shaken. 1 Flux, once per round, always ready.
- **Sequence (d8, Prime 3):**

| # | Surge | Build | Flux | At level 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sizzle Line | Wave + Blaze | 1 | +5, 3d6, Burning (4/turn) |
| 2 | Brownout | Bolt + Shock | 1 | +5, 3d8+3, Dazed |
| 3 | Dead Air | Bolt + Dread | 1 | +7, 3d8+5, Shaken |
| 4 | Wire Up | Infuse + Haste | 1 | Ally takes a Move + Action, advantage |
| 5 | Static Snare | Wave + Snare (Moxie) | 1 | +5, 3d6, Held |
| 6 | Overvolt | Bolt + Shock + Overcharge | 2 | +5, 5d8+3, Dazed |
| 7–8 | *Wild* | | | |

- **Emergence** (first fight of mission 4): she gains 8 temporary HP, every enemy within 30 ft is Shaken, and her first *Broadcast* costs 0 Flux.
- *What changed:* her primary attack went from +4 to **+7** against a T4 Guard of 14 (a 70% hit chance; at level 3 she had +5 against Guard 14, 60%). She can Surge every round, and Siren Song sends whole rooms at Rook. Her Limit of 6 is still her weak point. Every turn she Surges costs 1 Flux, so Surging every turn Overloads her partway through the second fight before a Breather. Mix in Mind Spike turns.

#### 13.6.3 Level 7 — Evolution II: Choir
Level-ups: **5** *Puppet* · *Afterimage* · Surge *Crowd Surge* (Infuse + Link + Sure). **6** *Glamour* · *Grapnel* · Surge *Arc Halo* (Wave + Shock + Reach) · Knack *Crowd Work*. **7** **Apex *Hive Mind*** (level 7, and 8 other Mind nodes) · *Arc Jump* · Surge *Blackout* (Bolt + Dread + Chain + Overcharge) · **Evolution II**.
- **Look (Splice Choir):** a crown of soft horns and a dozen small mouths singing along her arms (Bio); an antenna crown and a cape of fibre-optic cable that broadcasts on every frequency (Chrome).
- **Stats:** Chutzpah **+8**, Moxie +4, Gumption +3, Nerve +2, Grit +1. **Rank 4.**
- **Nodes (20):**
  - Mind (Bio): Uplink, Intrude, Commanding Voice, Iron Will, Read the Room, Psychic Scream, Puppet, Glamour, **Hive Mind**, plus **Siren Song** and **Crown of Will**.
  - Wiring (Chrome): Quickened, Slipstream, Wall Run, Overclock, Afterimage, Arc Jump.
  - Limbs (Bio): Natural Weapons, Spring Legs, Grapnel.
- **Numbers:** HP **44** (12 + 2 + 30) · Armor 1 · Speed 50 · Dodge **+8**, Endure **+5**, Resist **+6** · Flux Limit **9** (4 + 4 + 2 − 1) · Knit 8 · Prime **4** · Sequence **d12** (9 Surges + 3 Wild).
- **Attacks:** Mind Spike +12, 4d8+8 Psychic · Claws +8, 4d8+4.
- **Signature Surges (2):** *The Broadcast*, now +12, 5d6 Psychic, Shaken, and ***Live Feed*** (Infuse + Haste): every round, an ally takes a Move and an Action with advantage. Each costs 1 Flux, once per round. She can't use both in one turn (one Action), unless *Overclock* gives her a second Action.
- **New Sequence entries:** 7 *Crowd Surge* (2 Flux: target + 4 allies + 1 extra get advantage on their next roll) · 8 *Arc Halo* (2 Flux: +8, 5d6 Shock, Dazed, 30-ft cone or 60-ft line) · 9 *Blackout* (3 Flux: +12, 7d8+8 Psychic, Shaken, then half damage to a second target within 15 ft) · 10–12 *Wild*.
- *What changed:* +12 against a T7 Guard of 17 is an **80%** hit. *Crown of Will* turns the enemy's best Soldier into hers for the fight. *Hive Mind* lets an ally borrow her +8 Chutzpah for one roll a round, and gives one ally an extra Prime. She is the party's engine now, but with Dodge +8 against TN 16 she still fails 35% of the time. She stays out of reach and lets Siren Song point the room at the tank.

## 14. Appendix: Arcade vs Tabletop

The [arcade](https://xenodorian.github.io/BeelzRPG/arcade/index.html) (*Gauntlet mode*) plays these rules on a battle map, with the computer running the enemies. Almost everything it does is the tabletop rule, read on a grid ([Positioning](#64-positioning-theatre-of-the-mind-or-grid)). This appendix lists what it does **differently**, so nobody mistakes a video-game setting for a rule. When the two disagree, **this book wins**.

The full audit (every mechanic checked against the engine and the simulators, 2026-10-29) is in `Current_Work.md`, *Rules Audit*.

### 14.1 Difficulty Settings (not rules)
- **Party size is the difficulty.** Easy, Medium and Hard field 5, 4 and 3 freelancers.
- **Threat factors.** On top of the book's Hard budget, the arcade multiplies minion budgets and Boss HP by ×1.0 / ×1.22 / ×1.38 (Boss damage by half of that), ramping in over levels 1–3. These are tuned so a whole 20-fight run is winnable but not certain. Use the book's budgets at the table ([Threats](#105-building-an-encounter)).
- **Mercy.** In standard mode a lost fight can be retried from its start; each retry takes 6% off the enemies' HP and 4% off their damage. There's no tabletop equivalent: at the table, a lost fight is a story event ([Going Down](#69-going-down)).
- **GRAFT recovery.** In standard mode a freelancer who dies comes back at the next Lockdown with a permanent Scar or Fault. **Permadeath** mode plays death straight.
- **Fixed rhythm.** Every level is a minion fight, a Breather, a Boss (or centrepiece) fight, a level-up and a Lockdown. Minion fights use one or two creature types from one faction (at most 8 creatures); levels without one of the three Bosses use the closest-rated Elite, Brute, Controller, Artillery or Soldier, scaled like a Boss.

### 14.2 Automation (the computer plays a part for you)
- **Auto-play** ("Auto this turn", "Auto: rest of round", "Auto-battle") is a computer player. It is not a rule and it's not optimal.
- **Reactions fire on their own** when they help: Bulwark, Threat Sense, Precog (only for big hits), Unbreakable, Reflex Spike, Fortress, Omen, Deadeye, Hair Trigger, Opportunity Strikes. At the table you declare them.
- **Last Gasp** fires automatically the first time you would drop to 0 HP each Lockdown. At the table it's your choice.
- **Choices made for you:** a Splice's Overload keeps the better of the two tables; Bloom Lore rerolls bad results; Hive Mind gives its extra Prime to the ally with the fewest; Puppet picks its own target; Perfect Expression and Echo take the best Surges; Red Mist attacks the nearest creature; the primary node at level-up is picked automatically.
- **Enemy tactics** are a fixed AI ([Running the Game](#93-running-the-enemy-phase) lists the same tendencies as GM defaults). If nobody has been hurt for three rounds, the auto-player stops playing safe and walks in, so fights can't stall.

### 14.3 Information
- **Enemy stats are visible** (Guard, TN, HP, attacks, ratings). At the table you learn them with Analyze; in the arcade Analyze still matters for Exposed and Weak Spot.
- Dice resolve at once, so there's **no Juice reroll** of a d20. Juice can still set a Sequence die and Shrug a condition.

### 14.4 Simplifications
- **Initiative** is always the Moxie group check (no ambushes or surprise rounds).
- **Haste** gives the ally one immediate Action (not Unleash) with advantage, but no Move.
- **Mitosis** makes one weapon attack at the end of each of your turns and is destroyed by a failed Dodge (35% of the attacks aimed at you go for it).
- **Scars, Faults and injuries** gained in a fight apply from the next fight.
- **Grapple / Shove** offer Held or Prone (no push).
- **Not modelled:** cover, difficult terrain, elevation, Shaken's "can't move closer", Swarms sharing a square, Spore Cloud's "against attacks from outside" (it just Veils), and these node features: Adaptive, Arc Jump, Wall Run, Many Hands' second grab and Extra Arm's Push. Out-of-combat features (Read the Room, Keen, Uplink's mind-speech, Knacks) have nothing to do in a fight-only game.
- **Every creature fills one square**, Huge ones included.

### 14.5 The Simulators Behind the Ratings
The Boss and Minion Ratings in [Threats](#10-threats) come from `tools/encounter_sim.py`, which plays **without a map**. It abstracts positioning: an enemy Area catches each other freelancer with a fixed chance (30% / 45% / 65% for small / medium / large Areas), 15% of freelancer turns and 10% of enemy actions are spent moving instead of attacking, a Held melee enemy loses half its actions, and Fortress's Area halving is applied half the time. Those are modelling choices for theatre-of-the-mind play, not rules. Checked against the grid (`tools/grid_budget.js`), the budgets hold on a map except for Heavies, which cost ×1¼ on a grid ([Threats §7](#107-at-the-table)).

## 15. Glossary

Every game term in one place, A to Z, with where its full rule lives.

| Term | Meaning | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| **Action** | The main thing you do on your turn (Attack, Unleash, Dash, Brace, Help, Patch, Analyze, Taunt, Rally, Grapple, Shove…) | [Actions](#631-actions) |
| **Advantage / Disadvantage** | Roll 2d20, keep the higher / lower. They don't stack; both cancel | [Core Rules](#14-advantage-and-disadvantage) |
| **Amped** | A Primed Surge rolled as doubles (or made so by Emergence or Final Form): it costs 0 Flux | [Priming](#44-priming) |
| **Analyze** | Gumption action on a creature you can see within 60 ft: learn its stats, and it's Exposed | [Actions](#631-actions) |
| **Apex** | A tree's capstone node: level 7+, 6 other nodes in the tree, primary or secondary tree only | [How Trees Work](#31-how-trees-work) |
| **Area / Single** | Attack types. An Area still deals half damage on a miss or a successful defense | [Attacking](#65-attacking), [Areas](#642-areas-both-ways) |
| **Armor** | Flat reduction to each hit (minimum 1 damage); max 4 (5 with Unbreakable, 6 with Siege Hide) | [Damage](#67-damage), [Armor](#82-armor) |
| **Augment / Node / Root / Tree** | Your skill-tree abilities. A Root opens a tree; each tree has 10 standard nodes | [Augment Trees](#3-augment-trees) |
| **Base Form** | One of five body plans (Juggernaut, Skitter, Oracle, Alembic, Siren): sets your stats and your primary, secondary and tertiary trees | [Base Forms](#2a-base-forms--evolution) |
| **Bio / Chrome / Splice** | A tree's **Material**: grown or installed. A Splice has both | [Material](#33-material-bio-or-chrome) |
| **Bloom / Glitch** | The Overload tables for Bio / Chrome | [Overload](#52-overload) |
| **Boss** | A centrepiece enemy: sheds a condition at the start of its turn, gets one Interrupt per round | [Role](#103-role) |
| **Boss Rating (BR) / Minion Rating (MR)** | The party level at which one creature (BR) or a group worth 1 unit each (MR) is a fair fight for 4 rested freelancers | [Ratings](#101-ratings-br-and-mr) |
| **Brace** | Action: defenses with advantage until your next turn | [Actions](#631-actions) |
| **Breather / Lockdown** | Short rest (half Max HP, Flux 0, two per Lockdown) / full rest (everything resets) | [Rest](#110-rest) |
| **Budget / Units** | Encounter currency: a Hard (fair) fight is 1 unit per freelancer; each creature's units come from its rating minus the party level | [Building an Encounter](#105-building-an-encounter) |
| **Churn** | Quick action: +1 Flux, roll your Sequence die once more. Not on a turn you Unleash | [Churning](#46-churning) |
| **Close / Near / Far / Distant** | Theatre-of-the-mind distances (5 / 30 / 120 ft / beyond) | [Positioning](#64-positioning-theatre-of-the-mind-or-grid) |
| **Conditions** | Blinded, Burning, Dazed, Exposed, Held, Poisoned, Prone, Shaken, Veiled; most last until the end of the affected creature's next turn | [Conditions](#68-conditions) |
| **Crit** | A natural 20 on an attack: roll the damage dice twice | [Natural 20s](#15-natural-20s-and-1s) |
| **Death mark** | Gained while Down; 3 means dead | [Going Down](#69-going-down) |
| **Defenses** | Dodge (Moxie), Endure (Grit), Resist (Nerve), each + Rank. Players roll them against an enemy's TN | [Defending](#66-defending) |
| **Down** | At 0 HP: you can't act, you roll to stabilise, damage gives death marks | [Going Down](#69-going-down) |
| **Effect / Shape / Twist** | The parts you build a Surge from | [Building a Surge](#42-building-a-surge) |
| **Emergence** | The on-screen moment of an Evolution: temp HP 2 × level, enemies within 30 ft who see it are Shaken, first Signature use Amped | [Emergence](#2a32-emergence-the-moment-it-happens) |
| **Engulf** | A Heavy's Area deals extra damage for each freelancer caught beyond the first | [Traits](#104-traits) |
| **Enemy Phase / Player Phase** | The two halves of a round: freelancers act in any order, then the enemies act one by one | [The Round](#62-the-round) |
| **Evolution (I / II)** | The metamorphosis at level 4 / 7: new stats, +1 Prime, a bigger Sequence die, an Evolution node, a Signature Surge, a new look | [What an Evolution Gives](#2a3-what-an-evolution-gives) |
| **Exposed** | A condition: −2 Guard (enemies) or −2 to defense rolls (freelancers) | [Conditions](#68-conditions) |
| **Fair fight** | Won ≥ 90% of the time, someone Down 40–60%, a death ≤ 5%, 3–7 rounds (a Hard fight) | [Ratings](#101-ratings-br-and-mr) |
| **Final Form** | Level 10: once per Lockdown, +2 primary stat, two extra Primes, every Surge Amped for a fight | [Final Form](#2a33-final-form-level-10) |
| **Firmware / Knit** | The Chrome / Bio Material perks (swap a Surge / heal after fights) | [Material](#33-material-bio-or-chrome) |
| **Flux / Flux Limit** | Instability from Surges; Limit = 4 + Rank + Nerve. Going over it is an Overload | [Flux](#51-flux) |
| **GRAFT** | The contractor that hires the freelancers | [The Setting](#02-the-setting-in-one-page) |
| **Grid** | Playing on a battle map: 1 square = 5 ft, diagonals count 1 | [On a Grid](#643-on-a-grid) |
| **Guard** | The number freelancers attack against | [Threat Level](#102-threat-level) |
| **Heavy / Pack** | Enemy kinds: a Heavy has a big Area attack (costs ×1¼ units on a grid); a Pack enemy has group Traits | [Role](#103-role), [Building an Encounter](#105-building-an-encounter) |
| **Injury** | Temporary harm when you get up from Down (d6) | [Injury Table](#691-injury-table-d6) |
| **Interrupt** | A Boss's one extra action (no Move) after any freelancer's turn, once per round | [The Round](#62-the-round) |
| **Juice** | Reward token (max 3): reroll a d20, choose a Prime, or Shrug a condition | [Juice](#18-juice) |
| **Knack** | A narrow specialty; add Rank to checks that use it | [Knacks](#13-knacks) |
| **Last Gasp** | Once per Lockdown, when you'd drop to 0 HP: Overload on purpose instead and stay at 1 HP | [Last Gasp](#54-last-gasp) |
| **Line of sight** | A clear line from you to the target; walls block it, creatures don't | [Ranges](#641-ranges-both-ways) |
| **Long range** | Up to twice a ranged weapon's range, at disadvantage. Not for Areas, grenades or Surges | [Ranges](#641-ranges-both-ways) |
| **Mook** | The weakest enemy Role: a quarter of the HP, half the damage, fielded in numbers | [Role](#103-role) |
| **Move / Dash / Move carefully** | Your speed in feet each turn (split freely) / an Action for a second Move / half speed without provoking | [Your Turn](#63-your-turn), [Opportunity Strikes](#634-opportunity-strikes) |
| **Mutagenic X** | Enemy Trait: you gain X Flux when you fail your defense against its attack | [Mutagenic Threats](#55-mutagenic-threats) |
| **Opportunity Strike** | A melee attack (using your Reaction) when an enemy leaves your reach; enemies get one per round each | [Opportunity Strikes](#634-opportunity-strikes) |
| **Origin** | Your background: a Knack and a Perk | [Origins](#24-origins-roll-d6-or-choose) |
| **Overload** | Going over your Flux Limit: damage, a table roll, Flux back to 0 | [Overload](#52-overload) |
| **Prime / Primed** | How many Surges you roll ready at the start of a fight (2; 3 from L4; 4 from L7), and a Surge that's ready | [Priming](#44-priming) |
| **Primary / Secondary / Tertiary** | Your Form's three best stats (+3/+2/+1) and its three trees | [Base Forms](#2a1-choosing-a-form) |
| **Push** | Gain 1 Flux for a node's extra effect | [How Trees Work](#31-how-trees-work) |
| **Quick action** | A small extra on your turn (draw, stim, Churn, Target Lock, talk) | [Quick Actions](#632-quick-actions) |
| **Rank** | ⌈level ÷ 2⌉ (1–5): added to attacks, defenses and Knack checks; multiplies weapon dice | [The Roll](#11-the-roll) |
| **Reaction** | One per round, on anyone's turn: Opportunity Strikes and Reaction nodes | [Reactions](#633-reactions) |
| **Reach** | The squares next to you (5 ft); some nodes and creatures reach 10 ft | [Opportunity Strikes](#634-opportunity-strikes) |
| **Role / Trait / T** | The parts of a threat: its Threat level, its Role and its Traits | [Threats](#10-threats) |
| **Sample** | A harvested Boss or Elite part, spliced in as a Surge | [Samples](#73-samples) |
| **Scar / Fault** | Permanent Bio / Chrome Overload quirk | [Scars and Faults](#53-scars-and-faults-d6) |
| **Scrip** | Money | [Gear](#8-gear) |

| **Signature Surge** | Always ready (once per round), one per Evolution; not on the Sequence | [Signature Surges](#47-signature-surges) |

| **Stage** | Base, Evolution I, Evolution II, Final | [Stages](#2a2-stages) |
| **Stats** | Grit, Moxie, Nerve, Gumption, Chutzpah; set by Form and stage | [The Five Stats](#23-the-five-stats) |

| **TN (Threat Number)** | The number freelancers defend against | [Threat Level](#102-threat-level) |
| **Upkeep** | 25 Scrip per Chrome tree per mission | [Material](#33-material-bio-or-chrome) |
| **Wait** | Take your turn later in the Player Phase | [The Round](#62-the-round) |
